Texture Swapper v{version}
https://github.com/sonochiwa/sa-texture-swapper

GTA San Andreas 1.0 US plugin. Requires an ASI loader.

Installation
  Extract TextureSwapper.asi into the game directory or its scripts
  directory and start the game once. Put PNG files into the swapper folder
  it creates, one folder per TXD.

Created by sonochiwa. MIT license.
